{{Top|leg}}
'''Perat''' was the official currency of the nation of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. Displaying the features of the current ruling [[Perator]] on the obverse seemed to be the common practice.
